_notes.distance: in the meeting's native unit (yards in Ireland, metres in UK) — just be consistent; times are only compared between runs at the SAME distance
_notes.style: R = rails, M = middle, W = wide (as printed on the card)
_notes.split: sectional time to first bend in seconds, from the form lines
_notes.calc_time: calculated/adjusted time if the card shows it, else actual run time
_notes.grade: letter+number, e.g. A5, S3; lower number = higher grade within a letter
_notes.positions: in-race positions at each call (SPi column), e.g. '6544'
_notes.win_time: the winning time of that race (Win Tm. column)
_notes.track: track code of that run (Trk column) — splits/times only compared within same track+distance
_notes.minimum: trap, name, and recent_runs with pos/split/calc_time/grade/days_ago. Everything else optional.
